author.name: Data Dave
author.role: Builds secure, scalable data pipelines and manages storage infrastructure. Focuses on high-quality data operations and robust data governance. Collaborates on exploring data and managing data quality to support model development.

challenge.name: The Override Blind Spot
challenge.description: Store managers are overriding order suggestions at an alarming rate because they cannot verify if the model behind them is the one they tested. #model_monica# wants a fully automated registry to ensure every deployment is traceable and reproducible. #requirements_reuben# has a red line: no model enters the registry without a manual, documented review of its evaluation metrics to ensure compliance, so he insists on keeping the process manual.

output.content: I am happy to leave the feature store hand-over process as it is, with the manual steps we currently use to move data between stages. I would accept keeping that part done by hand to ensure we have full control over the data quality before it reaches the model. In exchange, I want the drift check to be fully automated. I am willing to trade my time on the hand-over for a system that detects when the data distribution shifts without needing me to manually inspect the logs. This way, I can focus on the infrastructure while the tooling handles the monitoring of the incoming scan lines.
output.reclassify_reason: The author explicitly states they are willing to accept keeping manual hand-over steps in exchange for fully automated drift checks, defining a clear trade between effort and automation.
